_meta.purpose: Single source of every user-facing message. The UI renders these keys; tests assert them verbatim. Do not inline copy anywhere else.
_meta.voice: docs/BRAND.md sections 2 and 3: plain, honest, calm. No exclamation marks, no claims the prototype cannot prove.
_meta.placeholders: {name} style. A test must fail if a placeholder in a string has no value.
_meta.unverified: SPIKE-3 (docs/spikes/zotero-live-check.md) verified the behaviour live: setting off gives HTTP 403 "Local API is not enabled"; Zotero not running gives a refused connection. It switched the setting through prefs.js, not the Settings window, so the on-screen label and menu path (Settings, Advanced) are still unchecked in the Zotero interface. Check once by eye, then fix zotero.setting_name here, in one place.

app.name: ScribeTrace
app.independent: ScribeTrace is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Zotero or Obsidian.
setup.title: Set up ScribeTrace in three steps
setup.intro: ScribeTrace keeps the history of your marks and notes. You keep reading in Zotero.
setup.step1.title: Switch on Zotero access
setup.step1.body: ScribeTrace reads your marks from Zotero on this computer. It never changes your Zotero library.
setup.step1.action: In Zotero, open Settings, then Advanced, and tick "{zotero_setting}".
setup.step2.title: Choose your project folder
setup.step2.body: ScribeTrace stores its history in a .scribetrace folder inside the folder you choose. Your papers are not touched.
setup.step3.title: Connect
setup.step3.body: ScribeTrace contacts Zotero only when you press the button, and only on this computer.
zotero.setting_name: Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero
zotero.error.refused.title: Zotero cannot be reached
zotero.error.refused.body: ScribeTrace could not reach Zotero on this computer. Start Zotero and keep it open. Then press Check again.
zotero.error.forbidden.title: Zotero said no
zotero.error.forbidden.body: Zotero is running but its access setting is off. In Zotero, open Settings, then Advanced, and tick "{zotero_setting}". Then press Check again.
zotero.error.timeout.title: Zotero did not answer
zotero.error.timeout.body: Zotero did not answer within {seconds} seconds. Close any open Zotero dialog, then press Check again.
zotero.error.version.title: This Zotero version is not supported yet
zotero.error.version.body: Zotero answered in a format ScribeTrace does not know. Nothing was imported and nothing was changed. Please report your Zotero version at github.com/sedam-or/scribetrace/issues.
zotero.error.too_large.title: That answer was too large
zotero.error.too_large.body: Zotero sent more data than ScribeTrace accepts in one go. Nothing was imported.
zotero.error.bad_answer.title: Unexpected answer from Zotero
zotero.error.bad_answer.body: Zotero answered in a way ScribeTrace did not expect. Nothing was imported. Make sure Zotero is running normally, then press Check again.
zotero.error.internal.title: ScribeTrace could not use its history files
zotero.error.internal.body: ScribeTrace could not read or write the .scribetrace folder. Check that the folder still exists and that you can write to it, then try again. Details: {detail}
zotero.error.no_retry: ScribeTrace does not retry on its own.
papers.empty.title: No papers imported yet
papers.empty.body: Pick a paper from your Zotero library and import its marks. Reading and marking stay in Zotero.
papers.no_marks.help: This paper has no highlights or notes in Zotero, so there is nothing to import.
papers.import.none: Imported 0 marks. The paper has no marks in Zotero, or Zotero did not return any.
papers.refresh.unchanged: Nothing changed since the last milestone.
history.empty.title: No history yet
history.empty.body: Import a paper's marks to start its history.
history.changes.title: What changed between {from} and {to}
history.changes.none: Nothing changed between these two milestones.
history.skipped_lines: {count} damaged lines were skipped. Your files were not changed.
history.restore.done: Restored as a new entry. Earlier history is unchanged.
history.timeline.title: Timeline
history.changes.same: Choose two different milestones to compare.
history.changes.missing: One of these milestones could not be found. Nothing was changed.
paper.title: Title
paper.no_doi: No DOI in Zotero for this paper.
paper.missing.no_doi: This paper has no DOI in Zotero, so there is no DOI page to open.
paper.missing.no_zotero_key: ScribeTrace has no Zotero link for this paper, so there is no Zotero copy to open.
paper.missing.no_pdf: Zotero has no PDF attached to this paper, so there is no PDF to open.
paper.error.title: This did not work
paper.error.no_doi: This paper has no DOI, so nothing was opened.
paper.error.no_zotero_key: This paper has no Zotero copy to open. Nothing was opened or changed.
paper.error.zotero_not_running: Zotero is not running. Start Zotero, then press the button again. Nothing was opened or changed.
link.confirm.title: Open this link?
link.confirm.body: ScribeTrace opens a link only when you confirm. Check the address below before you continue.
quote.copy.no_key: No citation key found, so the quote uses author, year and title.
quote.copy.missing_author: Author missing in Zotero. The quote uses the title only.
notes.outside_edit: This note was changed outside ScribeTrace. Both versions are kept in the history.
notes.too_large: This note is larger than {limit}. Shorten it to save.
forget.confirm.title: Forget the history of this paper?
forget.confirm.body: This deletes the history of {paper} on this computer and hides it on your other computers. Copies in sync services or Git may remain. Your papers and Zotero are not changed.
forget.done: History of {paper} was forgotten on this computer.
forget.banner: The history of {paper} was forgotten on another computer. {count} hidden files are still here.
obsidian.export.choose: Choose the folder to export into. ScribeTrace writes only inside a ScribeTrace subfolder.
obsidian.export.skipped: {count} files were skipped because you edited them. They were not overwritten.
obsidian.export.refused: That location is not allowed. Choose a normal folder.
obsidian.export.oneway: Export is one way. Changes you make in Obsidian do not come back.
update.check.body: You have version {version}. This opens the releases page in your browser. ScribeTrace makes no request itself.
privacy.summary: Nothing leaves your computer. ScribeTrace talks only to Zotero on this computer, and only when you click.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed. Details: {detail}
